releaseNotes:
## Downloads
- **`gamenative-v1.1.1.apk`** — Standard build. Recommended for most users.
- **`gamenative-v1.1.1-legacy-xr.apk`** — XR build for Quest headsets.


## What's Changed

### Added after prerelease
* Updated wrapper-gamenative with leegao's latest changes (support more non-Adreno GPUs) by @utkarshdalal in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/1771
* fix controller focus on common screens (library screen and library app screen) by @joshuatam in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/1747
* fix carousel view in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/1748
* Fix wrong branch size in install dialog in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/1738
* Fix controllers when keyboard and mouse attached by @utkarshdalal in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/1770
* fix: skip directinput and directinput8 components extraction by @joshuatam in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/1744
* Fix Workshop Mods for YOMI:HUSTLE when using bionic steam by @Nightwalker743 in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/1746
* Let users launch past multiple pending cloud operations by @utkarshdalal in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/1749
* Gamefix for Forza Horizon 4 by @utkarshdalal in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/1755
* Remove Personal Nexus API Keys and Temporarily Disable Nexus Support by @Nightwalker743 in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/1763
* Add Local Mod Import Support by @Nightwalker743 in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/1767
* Fixed external storage on modern build by @utkarshdalal in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/1768

### From prerelease
- Added wrapper-gamenative to support dx12 on Mali and Exynos devices in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/1668
- Add Nexus Mods support by @Nightwalker743 in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/1545
- Add Multi controller support by @phobos665 in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/1578
- Fixed carousel view, allow installing branches without downloading full game first in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/1711
- fix & improve bionic steam by @joshuatam in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/1687
- Fix ANRs when opening sidebar in-game by consolidating PulseAudio operations by @joshuatam in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/1663
- fix: large steam library crash & ANR on loading first-time Steam library by @phobos665 in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/1653
- Fix achievement notifications not showing by @phobos665 in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/1670
- feat: Add Steam collections by @VinceBT in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/1633
- fix: Optimize GOG and EPIC download by @joshuatam in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/1649
- Fix Rain World Workshop mod activation by @Nightwalker743 in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/1662
- Fix Oxygen Not Included Workshop mods by @Nightwalker743 in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/1682
- Allow uninstall of corrupted steam games in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/1681
- Add an animated focus ring across the library and in-game UI by @VinceBT in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/1655
- Fix clipping of the blur effect on the boot splash screen by @jonathan-dd in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/1642
- feat(): achievement sound on unlock by @phobos665 in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/1671
- Disable adrenotoolsTurnip for XR build in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/1679
- fix: Refactor AppScreenContent optionsMenu parameter to List by @joshuatam in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/1689
- Improve Shooter Mode runtime controls and settings by @Nightwalker743 in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/1641
- Fall back to English depots for unavailable languages by @VinceBT in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/1659
- fix: Small adjustment to fix epic offline mode caching. by @phobos665 in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/1566
- Add per-control appearance customization by @Nightwalker743 in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/1672
- Recommendations/discover page by in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/1676
- Fix orphaned cloud saves (ones that were never downloaded because of offline boot) by in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/1713
- Improve controller editor visibility and Xbox shoulder labels by @Nightwalker743 in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/1697

## New Contributors
* @jonathan-dd made their first contribution in https://github.com/utkarshdalal/GameNative/pull/1642
